content: मारक {%a.%} [मृ-णिच् ण्वुल्] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Killing, destroying, slaying. .{@-कः@} .²1 Any pestilential disease, plague, epidemic. .²2 The god of love. .²3 A murderer, destroyer in general. .²4 A hawk. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Death of all creatures at the dissolution of the universe. .²2 Vermilion (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>हिंगूळ</ns>).
